zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 设置搜索、磁力桌面动画与安装引导更新
changes: 设置采用分组文字侧栏，新增功能搜索，截图、浏览器连接、权限、隐私和更新可直接进入
磁力桌面默认使用 Dock 式平滑缩放完成展开、收起、抽出和回收，保留其他动画与减少动态效果
截图盒没有图片时自动隐藏，不再占用桌面布局空间
DMG 新增中英双语拖放安装引导、Applications 快捷入口和菜单栏启动说明
支持 macOS 14 及以上，包含 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 架构；应用与 DMG 均通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: Settings search, Magnetic Desktop motion, and installation guidance
changes: Settings has a grouped text sidebar and feature search, with direct access to capture, browser connections, permissions, privacy, and updates.
Magnetic Desktop uses smooth Dock-style scaling by default for unfolding, folding, extraction, and returns, retaining other animation styles and reduced motion.
An empty screenshot box stays hidden and no longer occupies desktop layout space.
The DMG adds bilingual drag-to-install instructions, an Applications shortcut, and menu-bar launch guidance.
Supports macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon and Intel. The app and DMG are Apple-notarized.
